description: This file defines the 'TranscribeCommand' structure, which implements a command-line interface (CLI) command for transcribing media files using speech recognition. It handles arguments for input files, localization, output formatting, and censoring options. The core functionality involves reading an audio/video file, performing speech transcription asynchronously, and outputting the transcribed text either to a file or standard output.

classes.name: TranscribeCommand
classes.description: A command-line command for transcribing audio/video files, handling arguments, performing asynchronous speech recognition, and outputting the transcription.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Asynchronously performs speech transcription on the provided media file and outputs the result either to a file or the console.
